scripts.restart: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if($p){ Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Output ('Stopped process ' + $p + ' on port 3000') } else { Write-Output 'No listener on port 3000' }; npm start"
